description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'HomeShell' that manages a bottom navigation bar with four different screens: Dashboard, Attendance, Reports, and Settings. It handles switching between these screens based on user interaction.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a scaffold with a bottom navigation bar to switch between different main screens of the app.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class for HomeShell, managing the current selected index and the corresponding pages.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, showing the selected page and the bottom navigation bar.
